head: Apple TV adds sign language interpretation on 13 November
dek: From Friday, 13 November, some Apple Original films in the Apple TV app can be watched with sign language interpretation, starting with Being Heumann. F1 gets both American and British Sign Language.
details: Way of the Warrior Kid and Greyhound follow later this year. Supported titles carry a Sign Language icon, and searching "with ASL" finds them. Apple says Deaf and native signers designed and tested it.
means: Deaf viewers can watch some Apple films with a signer on screen instead of only subtitles.
todo: Turn on Sign Language in the Apple TV app's settings, then look for the icon on supported titles.
